description: Six CV sequencers programmed as text, each step of a row naming one of twenty-six knobs, one of twenty-six inputs, or an exact voltage.

params.text: Sets the voltage sent when a row's pattern reaches its lowercase letter, 0-10V.
Advances every row by one step.
Returns every row to the start of its pattern.
Forces that row to restart its pattern on the next clock, which is how a newly typed pattern takes effect without waiting for the old one to finish.

inputs.text: A trigger advances every row that has no cable in its own clock input.
A trigger returns every row that has no cable in its own reset input to the start of its pattern.
A trigger advances that row by one step, and a cable here makes the row ignore the global clock.
A trigger returns that row to the start of its pattern, and a cable here makes the row ignore the global reset.
The voltage passed on when a row's pattern reaches its uppercase letter.

outputs.text: Carries the voltage of the step that row has reached, held until the next step.
Sends a trigger on the first step of that row's pattern.

notes: abcd steps through knobs a, b, c and d and then repeats, angle brackets hold an exact voltage such as 4.20, and @8 runs a sequence for 8 steps before looping.
curly braces pick one of the enclosed values at random on each clock, and empty braces pick from all twenty-six knobs.
square brackets around comma-separated sequences run each sequence in turn for the number of steps given after the @ sign.
the six text fields start empty and no row sends anything until a pattern is typed into its field; click the field and type, for example abcd to step through knobs a, b, c and d.
menu: Wiggle Knobs — moves the twenty-six knobs a little way from where they are, leaving the text fields as they are.
Randomize Text Fields — replaces the six patterns with randomly built ones, leaving the knobs as they are.
Knob Range — sets the range of the twenty-six knobs: 0-10V, 0-5V, 0-2V, 0-1V, -10V to +10V, -5V to +5V, -2V to +2V, or -1V to +1V.
